entry.title: Exquisitos Natural
entry.summaryHtml: Cedar, toasted nuts, coffee, light pepper and caramel sweetness lead a compact, wrapper-forward profile. The Ecuadorian sun-grown leaf brings more spice and dry wood than a shade-wrapped cigar, while the Dominican core keeps the smoke rounded and steady. At 33 ring the wrapper stays prominent, with a concentrated cedar-and-coffee finish rather than the darker cocoa weight of the Maduro.

note: Add the Natural/Sun Grown blend counterpart to the existing Exquisitos Maduro as its own standalone catalogue entry. The Index currently has both the single and box of 50 available; the box gives the best verified Australian per-stick price at A$21.50.
